title: Ivo and the Protocol
author: Jude Sterling
blurb: Paloma Voss, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
